name: Sagan Irisu
source:
Name: Iris Sagan
Sex: Female
Age: 18
Birthday: October 26
Profession: Sekiba High Senior, Internet Idol
Likes: Singing, Dancing, The Occult, Irises, Mizuki, Friends
Dislikes: Scary people
Hobbies: Singing, Dancing, Let's Plays/Game Commentary
Skills: Runs extremely fast

Iris is an internet idol (musician) belonging to the entertainment office Lemniscate. Her stage name is "A-set," but her fans call her "Tesa" ("Aseton" in Japanese). She is [url=/c86033]Hitomi[/url]'s daughter and good friends with [url=/c85763]Mizuki[/url], [url=/c107321]Kizuna[/url], [url=/c86548]Amame[/url], [url=/c85774]Ota[/url], and many others.

[Edited from the in-game character descriptions across all games]

[spoiler]She's the illegitimate daughter of [url=/c86035]So Sejima[/url] and [url=/c86550]Manaka Iwai[/url], taken in by Hitomi following her birth and Manaka's death.[/spoiler]
